RUSTUP="$(sed -rn 's/rustup\s*=\s*"(.+)\".*/\1/p' android/gradle/libs.versions.toml)"
RUST_TOOLCHAIN="$(sed -rn 's/rustc\s*=\s*"(.+)\".*/\1/p' android/gradle/libs.versions.toml)"
NDKVER="$(sed -rn 's/ndk\s*=\s*"(.+)\".*/\1/p' android/gradle/libs.versions.toml)"
sdkmanager --sdk_root=/opt/sdk "ndk;${NDKVER}"
git clone https://github.com/rust-lang/rustup.git -b $RUSTUP
export ANDROID_NDK=${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}
${BUILD_REPO_DIR}/rustup/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain $RUST_TOOLCHAIN --target aarch64-linux-android
source $HOME/.cargo/env
./build_appcore.sh
./build_android.sh standard apk
find . -name '*.apk'
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-size 16 --pad-like-apksigner --replace android/app/build/outputs/apk/standard/release/app-standard-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
